name: terrain
description: Seed-7 resident terrain diagnostics with ?residentCheck=1: five shots at bearings 0, 30, -30, 60 and -60, each waiting for its terrain commit. Edit probes record enqueue-to-ready/commit latency, readbacks, submissions, compaction, volume ledger and seam data; the idle oracle checks fine-graph connectivity and boundary/seam agreement. Settled and overview captures show the edited world; reload records startup/cache diagnostics. Shift is pressed before firing to unlock audio outside the first edit window. terrain-no-fx is a legacy comparison job: it conditionally stubs the retired ExplosionSystem only if the served view still imports it. When that path is absent, eval@stub reports the no-op and the job runs the normal effects path; its timings do not isolate terrain-only cost.

waitfor:(() => { const r = window.__tmtGame?.resident; return !!r && !r.oracle.pending && r.oracle.epoch === r.epoch; })()
eval@oracle:(() => { const o = window.__tmtGame.resident.oracle; return { checked: o.checked, failures: o.failures.length, first: o.failures[0] ?? null, milliseconds: o.milliseconds }; })()

eval@warm:(() => { const h = window.__tmtGame?.resident?.history ?? []; const m = h[0]?.metrics; return { cacheHits: m?.compiler?.cacheHits ?? 0, workers: m?.compiler?.workers ?? 0, initializeMs: m?.enqueueToCommitMs ?? null, mergeMs: m?.compiler?.mergeMs ?? null }; })()
